profile.address: 1180 Mt Diablo Blvd. Suite 300 Walnut Creek, CA 94596
profile.summary: DecoTech Systems is a California corporation based in Walnut Creek that provides audio/visual and information technology systems. It works as an integrator and licensed contractor for network, security and electrical infrastructure. Its website says it serves education, state and local government, and commercial clients.
